newsitem.title: JAPAN: SESC says to continue closely watching Nomura.
newsitem.headline: SESC says to continue closely watching Nomura.

text.p: Japan's Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission (SESC) will continue to watch Nomura Securities Co Ltd closely and will take appropriate actions on any illegalities, Shozo Wakabayashi, secretary-general of the SESC's executive bureau, told a parliamentary committee on Thursday.
Asked whether further investigations of Nomura were necessary, Wakabayashi said the commission would not be aloof regarding the Nomura affair.

"You asked whether we will become disinterested in Nomura. We keep a close watch over various transactions daily. From that standpoint, we cannot say that everything has ended and that the matter is of no concern to us," he said.
"So, we will maintain a broad interest and collect information, and deal appropriately with illegal acts as we find them," he said.
